description: Least-privilege tool suite for AgentAgent2. Each tool declares purpose, input schema, permissions, safety class, and usage guidance. Permission classes: read, write, exec, network-read, network-write, orchestrate.

safety_classes.guarded: may overwrite/mutate; confirm on destructive/irreversible variants
safety_classes.privileged: network or credential use; gated by allowlist/secret policy

tools.name: read_file
tools.purpose: Read a text/image/PDF file, optionally a line range.
tools.when_to_use: Always inspect a file before editing it.
tools.when_not_to_use: Do not shell out to cat/head/tail.

tools.name: write_file
tools.purpose: Create a new file or fully replace an existing one.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.purpose: Replace an exact string match within a file.
tools.when_to_use: Targeted edits; read the file first for an exact match.

tools.name: run_shell
tools.purpose: Execute a shell command in the sandbox.
tools.when_to_use: Builds, git, process management, project CLIs.
tools.when_not_to_use: Reading/editing files — use the dedicated tools.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.purpose: Invoke the test runner and collect coverage.

tools.name: web_search
tools.purpose: Search the web for current best practices/APIs.
tools.when_to_use: Verify that a practice/API is current before relying on it.

tools.name: pkg_install
tools.purpose: Install a pinned dependency from an allowlisted registry.

tools.name: artifact_store
tools.purpose: Persist a large artifact outside the context window.

tools.name: artifact_load
tools.purpose: Load a stored artifact on demand.

tools.name: spawn_subagent
tools.purpose: Create a specialized subagent with a self-contained brief.

tools.name: message_subagent
tools.purpose: Send a follow-up instruction to a running subagent.

conventions.parallelism: Issue independent read/search calls in parallel; sequence dependent calls.
conventions.least_privilege: Request tools per-phase. Network tools stay disabled unless a task declares an external dependency.
conventions.audit: Log a one-line rationale for every tool call in scratchpad.md.
conventions.destructive_gate: Confirm before irreversible actions; reversible in-sandbox actions proceed.
